name: What permits are required for an Airbnb-ready ADU construction?

mainEntity.name: What permits are required for an Airbnb-ready ADU construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building an Airbnb-ready ADU requires various permits, including zoning, building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical permits, as well as specific approvals if you plan for short-term rentals. In cities like Oakland or Berkeley, there might be additional local ordinances governing short-term rental operations that influence ADU design or use. We assist with navigating these requirements and preparing necessary documentation. Providing us with details about your property and desired ADU size helps us identify the specific permits relevant to your project early in the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Permits for an Airbnb-ready ADU include zoning, building, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical, plus specific short-term rental approvals which can vary by East Bay city.
